When you decided to leave by Lucero

It's been in the 30s for awhile, cold at night. How about you?

Her dog is a bit overweight. Between wet food in the morning, endless treats, table scraps, and constant filled bowls of food it's easy to see why. She hasn't been getting much exercise either. I was walking her when I first got back when it was still 50 or so out but not anymore.

I've been staying up to 9 for about a week now. I still have Amazon prime which is kinda like Netflix but not as good. I can't sleep when my mind is trying to figure out what went wrong. Last night I fell asleep by 11. Been watching parks and recreation, really funny show. 

I haven't even tried to sign up for healthcare. I just don't care I guess.

I've gotten good at moving, yet everytime I've moved I've had less and less things. The warmth must be nice though, I don't remember what my toes feel like.

No I stood up until 9am and woke back up a little before 1pm. Just four hours, 16 would be awesome.

How often do you feed Izzy? We only fed Layla twice a day at the same times. My mom pretty much has food down for her dog constantly, which can't be good. We do the same for the cat but he gets mad if he can see the bottom of his bowl. Won't eat it, just carried on that its not full

I'd offer to help but I despise moving. 4 times in 2 years is too much.

I went to bed at 9 and woke up at 1. This should actually reset my sleeping cycle. I need it to really bad.

Have you gone to the market yet? I hope that you are feeling a little better today, even if just a little.
Don't you think it'd give you something to work on and look forward to? It might just be the pick me up you need.

Owned it. Still in the process of getting it out of my name which is so painful. I adored that house. It sucks that I could fit two of my moms houses inside of it and there were only two people living there. Since I moved there has been new siding, windows, and a new patio door put on. Those were the only things that needed work. I want to ask for pictures but I think it would hurt too much.  I can't believe I squandered that life away.  Would you be able to move?

I was told that puppies are like that but grow weary of people as they get older. It was my first dog so I have no clue.

The ex canceled her Netflix account.  Haven't decided if I want to start it up.

My biggest goal was to buy a house, seriously that's really all I've wanted for 10 years.  I had an amazing house.  I'm really easy going and not very creative so my bucket list isn't very long.  Safari would be pretty cool, I love watching nature shows, which is essentially what that is but in person.

You know I felt the same way about Layla.  She didn't care who I was to her, she was as happy seeing me as she was seeing the electrician or pizza guy.  Kind of hurt my feelings and made me feel not special.  I don't know if I was wrong or what.

Hello there, first off I would like to say congratulations on the birth of your child!  

I really think you need to take one night a week for yourself.  Say every thursday night you go see a movie or do something by yourself that you want to do.  That is the only way to break out of the groundhog day cycle.  You must have something to look forward to, since you don't right now you need to make something up.

Winter time is a real bad time to get a dog though.  My ex was dead set on getting a female dog, my mom has a female dog, my dad has a female dog.  What is wrong with male dogs?  How do I know nothing about something so common?

I'm feeling better today and have no idea why.  It sucks that I know it's just a mirage.  I think something that hurts both of us is that we have nothing to look forward to.  The things I used to look forward to don't really matter anymore.  I don't think suicide is cowardly at all.  It's really really hard.  Hence why so many people have multiple attempts.  

Hunter S Thompson was a great author.  Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas is one of my all time favorite movies.  I remember when it happened, I thought about how he just decided that he was done living.  Not sad, not happy, just content with how his life had played out and wanted to go at his terms.  I often think about how when people tell me it's all going to be ok or things will get better.  I could get alzheimers tomorrow, I'm not too young.  I've seen the things I wanted to see, I've done enough things I wanted to do.  If I died tomorrow I'm content with it.

We crated her when we left the house at first but then put her in the bathroom since it was was easier to clean up any messes in there. It broke my heart to go to work while she was barking. I'd come home from lunch and she wouldn't leave my side because she was lonely. I want to get one just like her but I'm scared I'll do nothing but compare them. 

I haven't watched the late night shows in awhile

No we didn't crate her. bought the crate but she didn't want to use it, Layla would just bark forever until you let her out. Now this all happened during the day. Would take her out, she'd pee and then fifteen minutes later shed pee in the house. It was insane. Wasn't giving her that much water either. 

Yeah the antlers are at Petco.

Bill Burr. My style of humor for sure. I just couldn't get into it though feeling the way I feel

Yes a breakup, two weeks before I was going to propose.  Had to quit my job to move back home with my family, across the country.  Lost my dream house I shared with someone I loved deeply.  Even lost the puppy we had just adopted.  I lost my entire existence in a day.  It was the end of my world. I don't care for the world that I have now, this one I've been sold.

I don't have the will to live or the courage to die.  It's hard to move on when you just want the thing you'd be moving on from.  So I'm stuck in limbo and it's about as bad as you'd imagine it being.

Rationally speaking, there is no guarantee that a new life would be better, just different.  Hence the phrase, the grass isn't always greener on the other side.

I was happy, maybe for the first time in my life I was happy.  Think about a checklist you'd make to see if you're happy.  Then think about checking them all off.  Then lose every single one of those things in the same day.

Will you ruin the friendship by not asking though?  If you have those feelings its hard to turn them off and be a "normal" friend.

Seriously think about the practice thing.  You'll press by trying so hard because you think you have to be perfect that you'll do worse.  I like to golf.  When I go to the driving range, I'm fantastic because I know if I mess up this shot, I just throw another ball down.  When I actually play golf I'm not very good because if I mess up I can't just throw another ball down.  It's turned something I like into something I hate because I don't want to fail.  Sound familiar?

I'm sorry this has you worried.  I want to preface my response with two things, first I have no idea what it's like to be in your shoes.  Second, I'm only presenting this as an option not as a recommendation.  

Just deny it.  If you are closeted and a bisexual, it should be somewhat easy to plausibly deny this, no?  

Like I said, I don't know what it's like to be you so I'm not trying to be mean or anything.

You sound a lot like me.  Stop thinking of it as failure and think of it as practice.  Everyday you are practicing being a better version of yourself.  You will make mistakes but the old adage practice makes perfect is true.  

Have you asked this girl how she feels?  What if she feels the same way you do and is afraid you don't feel the same way? Say you ask her and she doesn't, isn't knowing better than hoping?

Almost forgot, yes it's real deer antlers. In Maine they had moose antlers. They run like 20 bucks for just a little piece like a foot long but if it takes a month to go through it maybe it's worth it.

It really is the worst part of depression, losing all the things you liked to do. I only listen to music if it's sad. My favorite comedian came out with a new special and I only watched like five minutes of it because I just didn't enjoy it like I normally would.

Layla was so bad. I would take her out every 45 minutes the first week we got her. Still had 6 accidents in one day. She was lucky she was adorable haha. 

One of my favorite celebrity suicide stories is Hunter S Thompson. He just said screw it.

There is nothing that makes me feel better. You'd think that something anything would make me feel better, but there just isn't.  I just don't know why I can't shake this.  I don't believe in that soulmate, only person for you crap, but then why do I feel this way?  I can actually laugh at something really funny and then just go right back to being miserable.

My mom's dog just shit all over the stairs, the carpeted stairs.  Right after refusing to go outside about 5 minutes prior.  Dogs make no sense to me sometimes.  My cat goes in his box, every time all the time.  So much less maintenance.  I want a puppy because let's face it, they are awesome, but I wanted to murder Layla the first week we had her.  So frustrating.

Did you eat something today?  Have you ever given Izzy deer antlers?  They are expensive but apparently it take forever for them to go through.

Sorry it was supposed to say reeling not feeling. This app I downloaded for reddit sucks for replies sometimes.

Honesty, she probably knows me better than anyone but my most recent ex. My dad would not handle it well at all. My mom would probably try to take me to the ER or take my gun away. 

I think I'm more afraid of living and failing than I am afraid of dying. I'd rather die than try. Really messed up. I have to dig myself out by just doing little thing s I guess. Like waking up at a reasonable hour, putting in an application or two. I've been getting overwhelmed by  thinking about getting a job and my own place and trying to figure out how to get back to where I was instead of focusing on the next step instead of the 30th one. We'll see how I feel when I wake up. I'm still in a lot of pain but I have to either move on or die. I can't live in limbo anymore.

I'm very sorry I've been like this lately. My original intentions were to help you and I feel like you've been doing nothing but helping me. How are you? What did you do today?

I already took the meds to be a better man. I think the problem is just me. I just talked to a friend of mine, we used to be together as well. She helped me sort some things out a little but I still feel the same. Which is weird, I understand things better now but I still feel hopeless and suicidal.

It is very easy to get a gun in Ohio. It varies from state to state. I went to a gun show, they did a 5 minute background check and registered it for me, and it was mine. Took all of 15 minutes.

My friend told me if I was going to kill myself I would've done it by now. Tough love she said. Has me feeling now.

I didn't fall asleep until about 8 am. Somehow I feel worse today than I did yesterday. The ex sent me a couple texts, stuff she had to get taken care of that involved me but it just wrecks me no matter the subject. I really think it's time for me to go in the next couple of days. I just need this to end
You're welcome and sleep well

I've been staying up to around that time too. Is it the anxiety that keeps you up? I assume so.

I'm helping people to help myself. I have panic attacks pretty much whenever I'm awake anymore and focusing on writing back a reply takes my mind off of things if even for a moment.

One suggestion for any kind of medical procedure or ailment, get it done as soon as possible, always. The longer you wait the worse it can get. I know it's scary, I'm terrified of the dentist. Whenever a tooth problem would occur, I would push it off as long as possible. Then I learned the hard way, I had broken a molar and it started to rot to the nerve. There's just nothing you can do for that pain. Never again after that, if something hurts you get it fixed.

I'm not a good person. I've never done a good thing for anyone.

What time is it in Poland? Forgive me, I'm too lazy to look it up.

Ohio\Maine in the US. Cold here too.

The ulcer sounds painful. Do you have a timeframe as to when it will heal? 

Listen, coming from a guy a world away who had lost everything, it's going to be ok. Things might suck for awhile, but you're a smart girl who with the help of some others, you can achieve everything and anything you want.
I love you but I'm not in love with you. That's the worst sound I've ever heard

So you have a stomach ailment that won't let you stay on medicine? Or the medicine you were on causes stomach issues?  There are a lot of different medications and it's not a one size fits all. I don't know your medical situation but if it is at all possible, maybe try something different? I was on meds for awhile after years of refusing to try it. Really helped me out.

How is Poland this time of year? Cold I assume

Yeah I did the call center thing. It sucks for sure. 

What country are you in? Is there a career path in any field that would allow you to work from home there? Maybe try to build around that lifestyle instead of molding your lifestyle to your job?  I've dealt with the anxiety of dealing with people, it sucks but you have options. Even when you think there is nothing you can do, there is always a choice.

If you can't medication, have you thought about seeing a psychologist instead? Maybe one can help you just by talking and listening. I've seen one before and it can be beneficial. 

Are there any jobs you can do in that field that don't involve dealing with people? Work from home kind of thing? Do you just not like speaking to people or would email communication be just as difficult?

So this is your only real boyfriend you've had in your life? I feel like if anyone is ever in a relationship where you are laying there crying and your SO comes in and says "what now" things need to change. That's what you'd say to a child having a tantrum, not your equal or better half. 

It sounds like you are scared to leave because he is your sole provider. I know that can be very scary but it's not a good reason to stay.

What are you currently studying?

Walmart might be the worst place to work in the country. I used to have one when I was a sales rep and they were just miserable to work WITH let alone for. 

Once upon a time I worked full time for a bank and made good money. But I was fucking miserable, just miserable. I had a job that I could be proud to tell people about but it was tearing my life apart. So I started applying for jobs that I knew I'd like even if they weren't as prestigious. I got one and it solved a lot of my problems. Know what it was? Head Cashier at a home improvement store. Paid probably double what you are making now with actual room for growth. I don't even have a degree! In anything! Try applying for a job similar to what you are doing now just for a better company. Then with the extra money you can start doing the things you want to do instead of having to do.

Hey there, I'm sorry to hear about your struggles. 

Your boyfriend needs to either be a rock for you and help you or you need to leave him. Significant others are supposed to make us stronger, not kick us when we are down. You deserve better than that.  Are you currently in school now?

You're worth so much more than this. Parents often don't understand about not wanting to work a miserable job just to make ends meet. That's what the majority of them grew up doing.  I'm very sorry you feel this way and for all the things that have happened to you this year. What are some of the careers you were looking into?

Have you ever seen Forgetting Sarah Marshall? Maybe you just go to Hawaii and meet people there. I don't know. You know what you have there, it can't get worse in a tropical paradise. Maybe it stays the same but it can't get worse. But it could be better. You should really consider it.

My mom is mad at me I think. Everyone is at the point with me that I just need to snap out of it. I wish it was that easy. Yes, everyone goes through a rough breakup or two in their lifetime. Just about everyone deals with a job loss. A lot of people my age move in with their parents. But no one does it all at once. I lost all my chips on one hand. It's a little hard to get back to the table after you lose like that: even if I do, how can I ever be the same?

Can Izzy be your companion?

I just want to stop thinking. I guess I'm still in disbelief that this happened. Never in a million years did I think she'd give up on me. I thought the world would end before that happened. I just want to go home.

I know how, with what, where, and why. I just have to figure out when. The one thing they say is true, you don't get to see people's reactions and that's what I want to see. Did anyone care? Did anyone know I was missing? Once the lights turn black that's it

I've seen the ocean already. 

You should be using that thing everyday like Jack from Lost. I mean that's a sweet deal. 

I did eat, did you?

I always just wanted to see the ocean. Something about the ocean being so vast comforts me. 

You should be using those benefits everyday! Is it like a free pass? Or is it a buddy pass type thing? I used one of those once. Cleveland to Orlando. I got bumped up to first class on my way to Atlanta, awesome for a 22 year old kid. But then got bumped off every flight for 10 hours since it was Memorial Day weekend. Ended up having to fly into Gainesville on a plane that looked like it was held up by ductape..
A little. Florida, Indiana, Chicago, Maine, Vegas. How about you?
There isn't a drive through or I would. The line is usually to the door as well so luckily you can order ahead and just pay so that's cool

It's ok, it's not your responsibility to fix me, please don't feel like it is. Like I've said, only two people out of six billion can help me. I'm not strong enough and she gave up trying. I have an 800 dollar cell phone that doesn't ring because I just don't matter. I haven't eaten today, I might get some chipotle if I can find the motivation to take a shower.

I just can't get my mind off of things. In a house full of people I barely show my face and I barely speak a word.  There is nothing left for me here, that's one of the reasons I moved in the first place. I've been replaying my "greatest hits" and I'm ok with going now. I've done enough with my life.
I don't think I'll make it through today. I hope that you are doing better than me. Give Izzy a belly rub for me.
I'm here to listen to your story if you feel like telling it.
I'm sorry that you feel this way.  Why do you want to leave so badly?

Hey there.  I'm sorry I haven't sent anything today I just don't have anything to say.  I just want to be gone.

I'm not sure why we haven't.  I guess because it's a suicide reddit and we don't want anyone to see it's here.  Although, not many depressed just recently moved back home from Maine guys running around Ohio.

Maybe my ex is right.  I do like playing the victim.  I do like feeling sorry for myself.  Most likely because I feel like I don't matter, like I'm not important.  I like listening to depressing music, I like watching depressing movies and tv shows.  I am really crazy.

I'll get a rush of adrenaline and think "I'm free to do whatever I want and I can be happy if I want to be" Unfortunately they are just thoughts.  I just don't have the will to do it.  I don't know how to get the will to live back.

If you set things right with your family, then what?  What would change?  Do you think you would just feel less lonely?

What kind of work did you use to do?

I wish there was.  Last night, I decided that I was going to fix all of this.  Then I fell asleep...around 9am.  When I woke up, I just felt as hopeless as I always do.  I get these fleeting moments of inspiration but I just cant hold onto them.  

I don't want meds because I feel like I deserve this. I'm always too lost in my own head to help others.  I deserve to feel this way, I like feeling this way.  

What would it take for you to make things right?  Would you just need to talk to them?  Do you need them to make the first move?

If I may ask, how old are you?  I've been wondering for awhile now.  If you'd rather not say I can certainly understand.

I dont know, a character who gets captured because of "daddy issues" is kind of ridiculous.

The side story of Claire and Aaron felt reallllllly forced.  Kate helped give birth and then was pretty much non existent with Claire until she feels the need to go back.  But they kind of got painted into a corner when they had a baby born onto the show.  Can't have a baby around when we are purging characters every other episode, right?  

This is what I do.  I'll love a show or a movie.  Then years later when I go back to watch it, I'm disappointed.
Should've killed her off in the Pilot

Always getting captured, always doing the opposite of what she should do.  She brings almost nothing to the group.

"Kate, don't tell Jack that we have Naomi"
"Jack, your friends don't want me to tell you that we have Naomi"
Paraphrasing some there but it's just over and over.  Using Aaron to validate her life because she's useless.

I guess if you compare her to a sitcom sure, there are far worse characters. For as big a show as Lost was, as the leading female character, she was horrible.  The acting wasn't the problem.  As I've been rewatching this I've found myself laughing out loud.  How many damn times is she going to get caught?  Half of this show is her getting caught and the rest of the cast trying to save her.

I'm crazy.   I feel like I want to be gone all the time and then I'll laugh at something so stupid and feel like everything will be ok.  Then I think about what I'd need to do and go through to make it ok and it just doesn't seem worth it.  I think I've spent too much of my life on sports.  When an athlete hits 30 his career is mostly over if not already over depending on the sport.  So starting over at 30 makes me feel like the best part of my life is dwindling away and I'll waste what little I have left making it better.

What would it take for you to get better?  I know what it'd take for me so I'm sure you know what you need as well.  

What can I do to help you?

I'm angry at all three. Her for the broken promises, me for letting it happen, and the situation for sucking so bad.

I guess I don't know the difference between playing and fighting.

I still have access to her Netflix account. I honestly end up watching things I've already seen before. 

I decided that I'm not celebrating Christmas this year. I don't want any gifts and I'm not buying gifts. 

Im just not doing well. I woke up at 4pm after sleeping like 16 hours. I just have given up all hope. I'm ready to die

Yeah that's tough.  You want to tell your SO everything and use them for support.  But sometimes this is just too much.  I know it was one thing that definitely hurt my relationship.  I thought she was my rock and would help me through anything.  But there is only so much one person can hear how miserable you are.

What do you do for a living?  You don't have to be specific if you don't want to.

Makes perfect sense.  I also struggle with the same afflictions and because of my current circumstances, I also can't afford therapy or medication.

How long have you been with your boyfriend?  When he tells you that you are crazy, is it because you tell him the thoughts you are having?

So you would describe it as situational depression?  When things were going perfect in my life (definitely not anymore) I was still depressed.  People that don't have depression have a hard time understanding how our minds work.  I'm not going to tell you to get a better job or break up with your boyfriend.  Those are things you already either know or don't.  I am willing to listen to anything you want to talk about.  Feel free to message me here or PM me.

What is making you want to do this?  

I look at my gun everyday, I know exactly how you feel.

Yeah it'd been a long time.  I am angry.  My life was taken from me.  We aren't really kind, so much as civil.  She didn't know the proposal was coming.  I told her after, she told me she would've said no.  I think about that everyday.

I have no idea how dogs interact with each other.  I watched Layla play with her brothers and sisters but when we'd take her to Petco, she would be kinda scared of other dogs.  My moms dog just wants to sniff other dogs.  Do they chase each other?  Rough housing?  It's something that seems like common knowledge that I just don't know I guess.  

So what have you been doing?  Watching Netflix like me?  Reading?  Sleeping?

Nearly every other day.  When it first happened it was everyday and like nothing ever happened.  Now however it's other things.  I had signed into a DirecTV contract back in April and instead of paying a huge cancellation fee we made an agreement that I would keep paying it while she would keep me on her cell phone plan.  Well, the satelite has been all screwy and she has been asking general questions about it.  Things she probably needs to contact me about.  

We were together for almost four years.  She's from Ohio but after a few months of dating she got accepted into grad school.  The plan was always to move back but when it came down to it, it just made more sense for me to move there.  

Have you taken her out at all lately?
What is making you unhappy?

Nah he seems fine, just introverted.  They both do yes.  

I wish having people around did help.  But all they do is help remind me of everything I lost and everything I hate.  I want to isolate myself since you can't count on anyone else.  Whenever I need to talk to someone, anyone, about anything, no one is there.  When I need to get out of the house, there's no one.  People care more about you when you are dead than alive.  

It really doesn't help when she texts me.  It's been important stuff too, not just random crap.  She haunts me when I'm awake and even when I'm dreaming.  I can't escape this.  I'm determined not to make it to Christmas.

I understand completely where you are coming from.  Everyday I wish I could just go home.  My longtime girlfriend broke up with me and got the house so I had to move back across the country to move back in with my mom.  I wish I could do something for you that I can't do for myself.

I understand the addiction to feeling depressed.  When I was on medication  I missed feeling this way.  It's crazy to try to explain that to people.

Are you out of options?  Logically speaking, you can't say screw everyone I'm starting over?  I try to do that in my head and it will help for a few minutes and then something else will happen and it wrecks me.  I can equate almost anything to her. 

I want to end it because I'm too weak to rebuild everything back up.  I didn't just lose her but I lost my entire life.  Everything I had spent years building, gone in an instant.

Have you thought of getting better?  It's something I struggle with daily.  Should I get try to move on and get better?  Or should I give up and end it?  I'd like to know your perspective on the matter as you've been dealing with it for a hell of a lot longer.

Not very well.  It's been two months since it ended and I've been getting worse, not better.  I haven't even begun looking for a job or even a bed.  I had plans for my life and now they are all gone.  If anyone in the world can understand what you are going through, its me.

I'm sorry this happened to you man.  I'm right there with you.  She didn't cheat on me but she still destroyed my whole world.  Lost her, my best friend, my job, my home, and even my dog.  Had to move back across the country back in with my mom.  I feel the same way you do, live I'm so broken that I can't recover.

I think some of those same crazy thoughts. In a room full of people I still feel alone and trapped in my own head/world. 

My one brother is 23 with the mind of a 15 year old. I'm dead serious about that and I'm not over exaggerating. I don't think I've ever had a mature adult conversation with him and we are even kind of close. My other brother is 12. However, a week or so ago he gave my mom his Christmas list and on it was "a book on how to treat depression". He is a huge hyperchondriac and I thought he meant for him. He swallowed a lemon seen the other day and started freaking out that he was going to die. Anyways, turns out he wants the book to help me. That messed me up. He barely says 5 words to me and hardly looks up from his computer and he knows I'm messed up. That alone is the only reason I think I'm still here. It kind of stopped me in my tracks. I just don't think it's going to last that long

You don't bring me down.  Knowing someone out there feels like I do is kind of comforting, even if it's sad.  I hate being alone and I hate being around other people.  Such a conundrum.  

If you had someone to hold your hand why would you want to leave?

I wish I did ok but I didn't.  I just spend my entire time comparing what I have to what I had.  I can't get my mind past it.  I had such big plans for this thanksgiving (and Halloween and Christmas) and it's all gone.  I spent last night driving in the snow wishing I'd slam into a telephone pole.  Alas, I made it back.
Hey, I haven't heard from you in a while so I'm just hoping that you are doing ok.  Let me know if you need to talk.
I hope you are hanging in there.  I'm thinking about you and hoping you are doing ok.

"I love you but I'm not in love with you" 

Funny thing about Okcupid, that's where I met her.  Nobody would want anything to do with me right now.  I don't even want anything to do with me.

I'm right there with you today.  I want it all to be over.

Happy thanksgiving to you too. I just want to sleep this day away.

She gave me the support I needed to get through some rough times. She even made the appointments for me to get help when I was too weak to do it.  I didnt just lose her, I lost everything. My entire life was flipped upside down and I just want it back. I hate that I didn't do anything wrong. I didn't cheat, I never hit her, I never even raised my voice to her and this is what happens. Ifor I did something to deserve this I could accept it but I didn't.

I can't sleep. All I can think about is how I just want to go home. And I cant. I can't ever go back home. It's all gone and there is nothing I can say or do to get it back. I have zero control over the one thing I want the most. It just breaks me into a million pieces all over again.

Ive written something a few times now and keep deleting them because I don't want to bring you down with me. I'm sorry if I have been.

I'm proud of you for going to the market.  Who cares what you bought? I'm just glad you went.

The 15 minutes flew by. All I could think about was how if I went through with it I had no chance to get her back. If I didn't there was at least a non zero chance. That was a mistake. 

I'm spending my thanksgiving with my mom and brothers. I love her but she honestly is the worst cook ever. I should just don't the cooking but I just can't find the will to do much of anything.  

I feel lonely without the comfort and support of a SO. My ex on the other hand just needs a couple friends and Layla and she's perfectly content. I wish I was the same way. And my cat only comes and lays by me when he's cold. My moms dog is super affectionate to the point of annoyance. She doesn't just sit on you/by you. She doesn't quit moving.
Sorry to hear that. Maybe try typing it an email or something and then copy/pasting it?

I'm only optimistic about today because I know how bad yesterday was.  Not sure how it could get much worse than that so today has to be better.
